name: Allen
bio: The name 'Allen' covers more than one man in these items. One Allen traveled the Medora route to Deadwood with Jones in April 1884 and a Superintendent Allen of the stage line left for the Hills in May 1885, while a General Allen of Fargo was mentioned as a possible nominee in 1886.

moments.label: Stage line superintendent left for the Hills

mentions: …They started a week ago yesterday morning and made the trip in forty-eight hours, passing on the road Messrs. Allen and Jones who had thirty-five hours the start.  According to Mr. Pennell they had a parrot and monkey kind of a time on the way down. They were caught on the open ridge…
Superintendent Allen went out on the coach Sunday for the Hills. Should he not return he can be sure of having left behind many friends made during his connection with the stage line.
…and sixty-four doubtful and contested. The opposition claim that there is a good chance of nominating Gen'l. Allen of Fargo or Judge Palmer of Sioux Falls, with chances in favor of the latter.
